reason: The service accepts text and decoded images, not Python scripts. H3 uses a server-owned workflow and fixed safetensors checkpoints. No user-controlled source is passed to torch.jit.script. This does not protect local users executing arbitrary Python code.

The reported attack loads an attacker-created .pt2 archive. Public submissions cannot provide workflows or checkpoints; all H3 model paths are server-selected safetensors. ComfyUI is bound to loopback and this service is limited to trusted hosts/networks. No claim is made about arbitrary local Torch programs or separately operated ComfyUI nodes.
